title: Strategic perception view
description: What one faction knows under fog of war. One view per faction for every hour that passes, built from the state at the start of that hour. Built by strategic/core, passed to the faction's controller. Spec: STR-005, STR-008, STR-009, STR-014, STR-017, STR-020, STR-021, STR-070, STR-092, STR-094, STR-096, SAI-002, SAI-003, SAI-005, SAI-015, SAI-017. Views are also built for factions created during play (resistance groups, STR-067, with IDs made at creation; a rogue PMC, STR-066), never for the civilian population or the off-map influences (SAI-002).

mapShape.description: Grid shape that sets adjacency and distance (STR-005, data/mapgen/strategic.json); on hex, knownRegions x, y are axial coordinates (STR-005)

recruitsAvailable.description: Its own recruit pool: soldiers its POIs produced that recruit can draw (STR-014, STR-096)

transit.description: STR-017: the move in progress, null when not moving

road.description: Road kind on the tile, null = none (STR-005)

roadTo.description: Adjacent tiles the road continues to (STR-005, STR-006); empty or absent without a road (spec choice)

roadCrossing.description: Water tile with a road: bridge or ford flag (STR-005, STR-006)

krugMarket.description: STR-005/STR-010: town or city tile with a Krug market

observed.description: Day and hour this information is from

knownSquads.description: Noticed foreign squads, the player's included

id.description: The squad's ID (STR-017); attack.target and setGoal.target name it

knownGoal.description: Only if intel reveals it (STR-018 goal)

knownTarget.description: The target of knownGoal (region, POI, squad or the player), present whenever knownGoal is; null for a goal without target (SAI-013 condition 3, spec choice)

vips.description: Own VIPs and known enemy VIPs with intel expiry (STR-045, STR-048)

relations.description: faction → relation; range and thresholds: STR-051

patronRelations.description: Only for a faction whose patron is a faction on the map (GEN-004, factions.patron): its patron's relation to every other faction (STR-051), for the patronStanding gain term (SAI-006; spec choice)

funds.description: This faction's own money (STR-092); other factions' funds are never visible

overdraft.description: Only under fundsMode scoreTerm: this faction's own hidden deficit (funds then show 0); lowers its AI scores (STR-092, SAI-014). Absent or 0 under hardLimit

contracts.description: Contracts this faction posted (role employer) or took with acceptContract (role contractor), with status (SAI-003, SAI-015)

contractOffers.description: Other factions' open contract offers this faction may evaluate (SAI-015), each with its id

events.description: Active events and measures that affect it (STR-050 event instance)

availableMeasures.description: Measures it may pick now with pickMeasure (STR-070)

escortRequests.description: Krug view only: pending paid-escort requests to answer with answerEscort (STR-094, SAI-017)

region.description: The Krug-market tile it waits on

relation.description: AI requester: its relation with the Krug (STR-051)

reputation.description: Player requester: the Krug's reputation toward the player

vip.description: STR-045 VIP as this faction knows it. Own VIPs: current state. Enemy VIPs: only with intel (STR-048); after intelExpires the entry shows the last known state

regionId.description: Current region (own VIP) or region from intel (enemy VIP)

guardSquadIds.description: Own VIPs only: the guard squads (STR-045)

guardSize.description: Enemy VIPs: guard size from intel (STR-048)

observed.description: Enemy VIPs: when the intel was acquired

intelExpires.description: Enemy VIPs: end of intel validity (observed + vip.intelHours, STR-048)

contract.description: A contract this faction posted or took (SAI-003, spec choice)

role.description: employer: this faction posted it; contractor: this faction took it with acceptContract (SAI-015)

contractor.description: Who took it (a rival PMC or the player); null while open

sourceGoal.description: The STR-018 goal the offer serves

status.description: open: posted, not taken; accepted: taken by a contractor; done / failed: ended (SAI-003)

event.description: STR-050 event instance { eventId, subjects, startTime, endTime | condition }

subjects.description: Factions, regions or POIs the instance is about

endTime.description: Fixed end, or null when it ends on its condition

condition.description: End condition when endTime is null (STR-050)

contractOffer.description: COPY of strategic_commands.schema.json $defs/contractOffer (unchanged since strategic_commands 0.6.0); keep identical (no cross-file refs in shared/schema.js)

id.description: Offer ID, unique per campaign; acceptContract.contractId and MGT refer to it

targetFaction.description: The faction the missions act against, if any (reputation acts, MGT-056)

sourceGoal.description: The STR-018 goal the offer serves

key.description: Per-mission key, unique within the offer (two missions of one type are told apart by it)

reputationGain.description: Deprecated, optional: MGT-056 now derives the reputation gain per mission from its pay band; kept for compatibility (management_requests holds an identical copy)

reputationGate.description: MGT-055 contract flags set by the offering faction: better = Friendly or better only, sensitive = Trusted only
